name: course-factory
description: Build an accredited instructor-led course as one-page HTML modules on trainee and instructor Android tablets, then publish it: the build order, the accredited-hours law in two tracks (the programme's allocation and how those minutes are delivered), ILO immutability, the canonical module shell and document page, screen craft, what representation actually teaches a concept, the instructional-animation law, the four-level asset pipeline, trainee task screens, a verification suite that tests the RENDER and not only the source, and a publisher that separates trainee from instructor content.
